Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Spiekwerk's coin store - picking a tier morphs the sticky bottom button's color and crossfades its label, from "Buy 300 Coins" in blue to "Invite Friends Now" in green on the free tier.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark sheet: "Get some more coins to keep creating Games" with tier rows (50 Coins - Free, 50 Coins - Rs 399, 120 Coins - Rs 999, 300 Coins - Rs 1,999 with a green MORE VALUE tag), a sticky bottom pill button, and - on scroll - a "You make this app possible." note with the maker's photo.

## Motion spec
Pattern: selection-driven button morph, ~350ms.
- Select: the tapped row's border brightens and a check tag slides in (200ms); the previous selection deflates (150ms).
- Button: the pill's fill morphs color (blue <-> green, 250ms, ease-in-out) while its label crossfades (200ms) with a 4px vertical shift; width animates to fit (spring ~340/26, 250ms).
- Free tier: the button turns green with "Invite Friends Now"; paid tiers stay blue with "Buy N Coins".
- Scroll: the maker note fades up 12px (300ms) as it enters view.

## Calibration
- The morph is in place - the button never jumps or remounts.
- The selected row keeps a persistent highlight; only the button and border animate per change.

## Reduced motion
Button color and label swap without the morph.

## Don't miss
- The green state is reserved for the free tier - it is a different action, and the color says so.
- Label and color change together, never one without the other.
